# Genova IPTV — Main Thread Apps

> Genova IPTV is a modern, privacy-first, ad-free "Bring Your Own Source" IPTV & M3U player available now on Android Phone, Android Tablet, and Android TV / Google TV (with iPhone iOS coming next, followed by Apple TV tvOS, iPadOS, and Desktop starting with macOS). Built with Material Design 3, it supports remote M3U/M3U8 playlists and compatible streaming APIs with Live TV + EPG, VOD, Series, Continue Watching, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), and multi-provider management. No user account required; all playlists and credentials stay locally on the user's device.

## Why Genova IPTV (2026)

- **Privacy-first & local-first**: Playlists, provider credentials, and watch history are stored strictly on-device. No account required, zero ads, no data sold.
- **Adaptive multi-screen UI**: Ergonomic one-handed navigation on Android phones, split-pane layout on tablets, and a dedicated 10-foot remote (D-pad) interface on Android TV with Watch Next integration.
- **Platform rollout roadmap**: Available now on Android Phone, Tablet & Android TV. Upcoming rollout order: 1) iPhone (iOS), 2) Apple TV (tvOS), 3) iPad (iPadOS), 4) Desktop (macOS first, then Windows & Linux).
- **Multi-source & offline-first**: Supports remote M3U/M3U8 playlist URLs and compatible streaming APIs, with multiple concurrent providers, background sync, and instant local catalog browsing.
- **Complete playback & discovery**: Live TV with integrated Electronic Program Guide (EPG), VOD movies, TV series, Continue Watching rails, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), and real-time universal search.
- **Transparent pricing**: Browsing, favorites, and the built-in demo catalog are free. Full provider playback includes a 7-day free trial, then €2.99/month or €19.99/year via Google Play (covering Android Phone, Tablet, and Android TV, with launch price lock for active subscribers).

*Note: Genova IPTV is a player only and does not provide, host, or resell any IPTV channels or media content. Users bring their own legal streaming source.*
